mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loyalty.tier_evaluation (id, tenant_id, program_id, member_id, tier_scheme_id, evaluation_period_id, period_start, period_end, current_tier_id, target_tier_id, decision, transition_mode, source_event_id, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{programId}, #{memberId}, #{schemeId}, #{evaluationPeriodId}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{currentTierId}, #{targetTierId}, #{decision}, #{transitionMode}, #{sourceEventId}, #{idempotencyKey}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, program_id, member_id, tier_scheme_id, evaluation_period_id, period_start, period_end, current_tier_id, target_tier_id, decision, transition_mode, source_event_id, idempotency_key, evaluated_at FROM loyalty.tier_evaluation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND program_id = #{programId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND tier_scheme_id = #{schemeId} ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC
